answer.reason: G-III is a fashion apparel and accessories brand portfolio (owned and licensed) built around design, sourcing, distribution and marketing. Its brands are Marc Jacobs, Donna Karan, DKNY and Karl Lagerfeld. Build-A-Bear sells customizable plush toys and gift sets in its own Workshops and online, many under licensed characters (Disney, Sanrio, Pokémon). The products differ: fashion apparel versus toys and plush. The main buyers differ too: G-III sells to retailers, while Build-A-Bear sells to families and gift buyers in its own stores. The only overlap is generic: both are brand owners that use licensed IP and sell through some own retail and online channels.
